data.body:
## Fix implemented — Gerrit change 1260

Translation site: the DC transport's JiraDataCenterTransport._assign, mirroring Cloud
(adapters/jira/acli.py, bug 85a1), which does the same routing inside its own transport.
outbound_differ.py was NOT touched: its "" resolution is shared with Cloud, and Cloud
already handles the empty value in its own transport, so the differ is not the defect site.

### Which sentinel, verified AT RUNTIME (jira==3.10.5, not read off a docstring)

Probed JIRA.assign_issue with a recording session and _is_cloud=False. Self-hosted payload
is {"name": user_id}:

  None   -> PUT issue/<key>/assignee {"name": None}  == UNASSIGNED  <- the correct sentinel
  -1     -> PUT {"name": -1}     == Jira "Automatic" (project default assignee), NOT unassign
  "-1"   -> PUT {"name": "-1"}   == likewise "Automatic", NOT unassign
  ""     -> falls through _get_user_id to search_users(user=""), and then EITHER raises
            JIRAError("No matching user found for: ''") when the search is empty, OR --
            the worse mode the J11 cell flagged -- PUTs the FIRST search hit, assigning an
            ARBITRARY user. Both modes reproduced.

So None, not -1: the -1 sentinels are a different operation and would have been a wrong fix.
The guard also normalises blank-but-not-empty strings, which carry the same arbitrary-match
hazard through search_users(user=" ").

### RED first, then mutation-checked

New test: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_unassign_751e.py (8 cases). Before the change,
5 of 8 RED:

  test_empty_outbound_assignee_actually_unassigns[]
    AssigneeNotFoundError: assignee '' could not be resolved to a DC user on DIG-1:
    HTTP Error 400: No matching user found for: ''
  test_empty_assignee_never_assigns_an_arbitrary_search_hit[] (and ['   '], ['\t'])
    AssertionError: assignee='' must not be resolved to a user; fields.assignee is
    {'name': 'bob'}
  test_unassign_co_submitted_with_an_editable_field_does_both
    AssigneeNotFoundError (same shape as above)

The 3 that were already GREEN pin what must not regress: assignee=None already unassigned,
a real username already assigned, and a bogus non-empty username already raised.

MUTATED: removed the two-line empty/blank -> None guard from _assign;
FAILED: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_unassign_751e.py -- the same 5 cases, with the
same two messages above. No AttributeError/ImportError, so the mutation is valid.

The oracle is positive about absence throughout: every assertion reads the resulting
fields.assignee and requires it to be None (plus the vendor payload == {"name": None} and
search_calls == []). None of them settle for "no exception raised" -- a silent success is
this defect's entire character.

### Normal path proven intact

test_non_empty_assignee_still_assigns asserts fields.assignee == {"name": "bob"}, the vendor
payload == {"name": "bob"}, and that the user search still ran with {"user": "bob",
"maxResults": 20}. test_unresolvable_non_empty_assignee_still_raises asserts a bogus
non-empty assignee still raises AssigneeNotFoundError and does NOT clear the field.
Full tests/unit/rebar_reconciler suite: 1980 passed, 1 xfailed.

### Gates

transport.py 733 -> 756 lines, under the 800 cap. docs/env-vars.md regeneration
(scripts/gen_env_registry.py) produced no diff -- the edit sits below every env read.
tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_outbound_unassign_round_trips was
not touched; it should turn green on the next harness run.
